author: primary Astra; research only
method: Judgmental, mutually exclusive event-path probability allocation; not a fitted frequency or confidence interval. Central rounded to whole percentage points.

paths.path: Scientific confirmation with qualifying government statement
paths.basis: NASA UAP FAQ updated Oct8 has no credible ET evidence; Mars releases explicitly require further study; about10.8 days remain.

paths.path: Definitive political/military/agency assertion without established scientific proof, absent first path
paths.basis: Literal rule requires statement, not independent proof; wide set of officials and active UAP-disclosure attention leaves statement risk. Assigned tail, no calibrated event rate.

paths.path: Already-made/missed or ambiguous statement accepted YES, absent earlier paths
paths.basis: No lower-bound clause; historical/political literal ambiguity; AARO direct FAQ403 and no exhaustive all-official survey. Captured WhiteHouse page explicitly means immigration and NASA biosignatures remain potential, so those observed texts are not central YES evidence.

sensitivity: Broad YES0.5–15% represents low-statement vs active-disclosure/loose-adjudication regimes, not observed frequencies. A strict science-only model would understate literal risk. Near date does not make NO risk-free. Any definitive qualifying new statement overwhelms this baseline.
entry_stress: 5pp absolute tail-monitoring reserve => NO92%, YES0%; K=5 measured-tail licence unavailable because the tail is a judgment, not a measured resolving series. No execution under current model or600-review restriction.
quote_independence: Primary has not inspected outcome prices from current helper Gamma or CLOB before saving this model; helper Gamma identity was parsed but prices not printed. This is a current-author attestation, not proof that no earlier session encountered quotes.
